中国宁夏地区单一致敏与多致敏过敏性鼻炎患者的过敏原提取物致敏模式

Allergen extract-based sensitization patterns in mono-sensitized versus multi-sensitized patients with allergic rhinitis in Ningxia, China.

中文摘要

背景：与单一致敏患者相比，多致敏的过敏性鼻炎（AR）患者症状更严重，且发生哮喘并发症的风险更高。过敏原比例与地理分布密切相关，但中国宁夏地区多致敏AR患者的详细致敏谱仍未被充分探索。 目的：研究宁夏地区多致敏AR患者吸入性过敏原的分布及相关因素，为个体化治疗提供数据基础。 方法：回顾性分析2018年1月至2022年8月在银川市第一人民医院诊断为AR并接受血清过敏原特异性IgE（sIgE）检测的1,180例患者。排除70例对全部10种吸入性过敏原检测均为阴性的患者后，分析1,110例至少一种吸入性过敏原阳性的患者。其中，826例≥2种吸入性过敏原阳性（多致敏组）与284例单一吸入性过敏原阳性（单一致敏组）进行比较。 结果：（1）74.4%（826/1,110）的致敏AR患者为多致敏。（2）主要吸入性过敏原为艾蒿（74.1%）、豚草（54.7%）和树花粉混合物（49.2%）。（3）按平均sIgE强度排序，前三位过敏原为艾蒿（3.65）、猫皮屑（3.06）和屋尘（3.00）。（4）多致敏与年龄（χ²=116.032，P<0.001）、食物过敏共病（χ²=107.622，P<0.001）、就诊季节（χ²=58.475，P<0.001）、COVID-19大流行时期（χ²=85.513，P<0.001）和民族（χ²=64.627，P<0.001）显著相关。COVID-19后，多致敏比例从80.0%下降至55.2%。 结论：花粉类过敏原，尤其是艾蒿，是宁夏地区多致敏AR患者最常见的诱因，呈现出明显的区域和人口学模式。全面的过敏原检测、本地花粉监测和减少暴露对于管理这一高危亚组至关重要。

英文摘要

Patients with allergic rhinitis (AR) and multi-sensitization experience more severe symptoms and a higher risk of asthma complications compared to those with mono-sensitization. Allergen proportion is closely linked to geographical distribution, yet detailed profiles of multi-sensitized AR patients in Ningxia, China, remain underexplored. To investigate the distribution of inhaled allergens and associated factors in multi-sensitized AR patients in Ningxia, providing a data foundation for individualized treatment. A retrospective analysis included 1,180 AR patients diagnosed at Yinchuan First People's Hospital (January 2018-August 2022) who underwent serum allergen-specific IgE (sIgE) testing. After excluding 70 patients who tested negative for all 10 inhalant allergens, 1,110 patients with at least one positive inhalant allergen were analyzed. Among them, 826 patients with ≥2 positive inhalant allergens (multi-sensitized group) and 284 with a single positive inhalant allergen (mono-sensitized group) were compared. (1) 74.4% (826/1,110) of sensitized AR patients had multi-sensitization. (2) The predominant inhaled allergens were mugwort (74.1%), ragweed (54.7%), and tree mix (49.2%). (3) The top allergens by mean sIgE intensity were mugwort (3.65), cat dander (3.06), and house dust (3.00). (4) Multi-sensitization was significantly associated with age (χ 2 = 116.032, P < 0.001), food allergy comorbidity (χ 2 = 107.622, P < 0.001), season of consultation (χ 2 = 58.475, P < 0.001), COVID-19 pandemic period (χ 2 = 85.513, P < 0.001), and ethnicity (χ 2 = 64.627, P < 0.001). Post-COVID-19, the proportion of multi-sensitization decreased from 80.0% to 55.2%. Pollen allergens, particularly mugwort, are the most common triggers for multi-sensitized AR patients in Ningxia, demonstrating distinct regional and demographic patterns. Comprehensive allergen testing, local pollen monitoring, and exposure reduction are crucial for managing this high-risk subgroup.
